1399-11-25 is 1399-11-25.  
124 days before:  
1399 has 365 days (non-leap in Jalali? Context says Gregorian, so 1399 is a year, treat as Gregorian).  
1399 is not a leap year (divisible by 4? 1399/4=349.75, not divisible).  
From 1399-11-25 back:  
October has 31 days, September 30, August 31, July 31, June 30, May 31, April 30, March 31, February 28, January 31.  
Count back:  
25 Nov → 1 Nov is 24 days back (124-24=100 left).  
October 31 days → back to 1 Oct is 31 days (100-31=69 left).  
September 30 days → back to 1 Sep is 30 days (69-30=39 left).  
August 31 days → back to 1 Aug is 31 days (39-31=8 left).  
July has 31 days, so 8 days before 1 Aug is July 24.  

Thus: 1399-07-24.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1399-07-24
